name: Chercos (Spain)
description: Vertically divided Prussian blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Chercos (a tree on white and figures on blue).
history: Authorised by the Junta de Andalucía in December 2002, the symbols were adopted in January 2007; the flag is a rectangular cloth one and a half times longer than wide, parted per pale, Prussian blue at the hoist and white at the fly.
